traceability.manual-fill: Single manual long entry with existing fixed SL.
traceability.supply-policy: Explicit IDs and risk supplied to Hermes harness.
traceability.queue-handoff: CLI queues ADOPTING without broker writes; preview has no exchange I/O.
traceability.verify-account: Existing Supervisor validates ledger/current position/risk/SL/ownership under account lock.
traceability.import-owned: Atomic import -> PROTECTING; invalid INTERVENTION has no import/new entry; recover and pending cancellation are bounded.
traceability.send-native: Subsequent reconciliation submits native trail once. Concurrent local nine-minute policy shares the same worker; local exits reduce-only.
traceability.trail-readback: Waiting has no active coverage; matching active moves to PROTECTED.
traceability.exit-cleanup: Either signal exits; fixed/native orders retained until flat; residual reconciliation and cleanup; UNKNOWN no resend or provider switching.

artifact_copy: Browser inspection uses byte-identical evidence copy; SHA-256 equals delivered HTML.
observations: No reusable new skill observation; parent owns observer notebook.
limitations: Design-stage target, not a claim of deployed or live exchange validation.
Hermes is a harness-neutral CLI example, not an implemented Hermes SDK integration.
Independent verification remains a later stage.
